name: Tenable
description: Query assets, search vulnerability exposure, and manage tags and tickets through Tenable's hosted Hexa AI MCP service

contributions.name: Tenable
contributions.description: Search Tenable assets and exposures; create tickets and apply tags with explicit approval

secrets.label: Tenable API keys formatted as accessKey=<KEY>;secretKey=<SECRET>

contributions.instructions: Use a least-privilege Tenable API key; the hosted service requires an eligible Tenable One license. Asset searches are read-only. Confirm with the user before tag creation, tag application, ticket creation, or assignee notification because these actions mutate Tenable One state.
